stem: How does Addie in the selection from The Boston Girl differ from Sybil in the poem "Sybil Ludington's Ride"?

options.label: F
options.text: Addie has doubts about her abilities, while Sybil is certain of her abilities.

options.label: G
options.text: Addie lacks a sense of pride, while Sybil feels proud of herself.

options.label: H
options.text: Addie is supported by another character, while Sybil has no support.

options.label: J
options.text: Addie asks for help, while Sybil refuses to accept help.
